x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
smallest_difference = 2e9
numerator = 0
denominator = 1
ratio = x / y

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a = int(ratio * i)
    diff_a = abs((a / i) - ratio)
    diff_b = abs(((a + 1) / i) - ratio)
    if diff_a <= diff_b and diff_a < smallest_difference:
        smallest_difference = diff_a
        numerator = a
        denominator = i
    elif diff_b < diff_a and diff_b < smallest_difference:
        smallest_difference = diff_b
        numerator = a + 1
        denominator = i

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
</translated_code>
